scripts.dev:api: node scripts/py.mjs -m uvicorn hbt.main:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir backend/hbt
scripts.lint: npm run lint:py && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:py: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check backend && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format --check backend
scripts.format: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format backend && prettier --write .
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test:web
